crossRefs.note: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning…

people.name: Ophrah
people.line: A town in Benjamin and a place in Manasseh

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Shual
people.line: Region raided by Philistines during Saul's reign

translations.web: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;
translations.bsb: And raiders went out of the Philistine camp in three divisions. One headed toward Ophrah in the land of Shual,
translations.kjv: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
translations.asv: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual;
